scope: One mover-rating feature experiment; all848already-unblindeddevelopment. No independent test or beginner-curve claim.

feature_sets.original75: Original75semantic predictors and their explicit missing indicators.
feature_sets.plus_rating: Add only actual mover PGN rating as one continuous field and its explicit missing indicator. No opponent rating, account feature, date, time control or extra interactions.

evaluation.group_cv: Reuse original five game/identical-before-position connected-component folds. Original75results/predictions reused without refitting.
evaluation.leave_one_account_out: Five prespecified held-out accounts in order nelsi,hansen,KNVB,GothamChess,Hikaru. Purge all training cases in connected groups touching that account; account is fold metadata only, never a predictor.
evaluation.reporting: For every feature set, scheme, operating point and held-out account, report all848/core818/panel30 metrics and rating-range coverage. No account/fold selection.

training_runs: Five grouped rating fits; five LOAO original fits; five LOAO rating fits; one full-data descriptive rating fit. No baseline grouped/full refits and no other configuration.
eligibility: Unchanged eligible current/prior window training, final both-windowAND plus raw offer/two roots/quality<=5/after-floor>=-100/confidence guards.
rating: PGN WhiteElo/BlackElo for the actual mover identified by before-position turn. Null stays null; never use account averages.
published_claim: Chess.com describes more generous sacrifice criteria for newer players. This does not identify its exact rating source or private formula.
stop: No capacity/threshold grid, added predictors, engine/browser jobs, app/public changes or automatic followup.
